Vesper Churnmoat is the corrupted armor rummager of the Flame's Radiance, located at Morgaen's Tears in Hallowfall as part of the Flame's Radiance and the Nightfall scenario. He sells Champion 1 weapons and accessories with the Nightfall purple tint in exchange for a Radiant Emblem of Service, awarded from the weekly Nightfall scenario quest. Matching armor pieces drop from the Confiscated Cultist's Bag from daily quests or the the Nightfall scenario boss.
Verdant Seed has a chance to drop from all herbs throughout Khaz Algar. It can be planted at Beledar's Bounty of Hallowfall to grow into a random Khaz Algar herb.
